THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
099
Behind the image
77 / Noir Tweed
REFERENCE 5937.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 055
Art direction: Black and white against a bright studio wall, strong shadow play, crisp tweed texture
and a stiff, poised stance.
Photorealistic full-length vertical studio fashion photograph of an original adult woman with dark
hair pulled back loosely, a neutral, serious expression and natural makeup, standing straight and
facing the camera with her arms relaxed at her sides. She wears an oversized black textured tweed
jacket with a crisp white collar, large pearl buttons and wide patch pockets, over a fitted black
pleated mini skirt and short black shorts, white ribbed knee socks and tall black leather boots with
multiple silver buckle straps. An open old book with cream pages rests on the floor beside her,
casting a long soft shadow across a bright white plaster wall. Soft diffused daylight, black and
white palette, crisp tweed texture, clean minimalist fashion editorial, no text or logos.
78 / Ivory Column
REFERENCE 5960.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 056
Art direction: Ivory and cream against warm sand and blue carpet, a grounded full-length pose
and soft, even daylight.
Photorealistic full-length vertical fashion editorial of an original adult woman with long, straight
light-brown hair falling past her shoulders, a calm, direct gaze and soft natural makeup with a
slightly parted lip. She wears a fitted ivory long-sleeve turtleneck and a flowing asymmetric ivory
midi skirt with a sheer, uneven hem, a cream ribbed sock visible at one ankle, a dark leather
crossbody bag with a wide strap, and tall brown distressed leather knee boots with buckled straps.
Standing on a plush cobalt-blue carpet, with stacks of books on either side, in front of a textured
warm sand-colored plaster wall, soft directional daylight, ivory, sand and cobalt palette, crisp knit
texture, contemporary autumn fashion campaign, no text or logos.
